      "quote": "in the AI segment, we anticipate an improvement in performance on the back of better volumes for agrochemical-linked intermediates from Europe as well as other geographies",

      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call / Quarterly financials Dec 2025"

    {
      "promise": "Upstream integration assets to be fully operational in Q4 FY26",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "upstream integration assets, which are expected to be fully operational in Q4 FY26.",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. Later calls discuss MIBK/MIBC commissioning in Q2 FY27, but do not explicitly confirm the status of the specific upstream assets mentioned in Nov 2025.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "May 2026 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK/MIBC projects commissioning in Q2 FY27",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "our multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK, MIBC projects, which are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.",
      "outcome": "Aug 2026 call confirms MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone commissioned in August (Q2 FY27), with others on track for the same quarter.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Commission MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone in August 2026",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.",
      "outcome": "Q2 FY27 results show a significant revenue jump to INR 3,091 crore, supporting the commissioning and scale-up of new assets.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call / Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Q3 FY27 EBIT % to be between Q1 and Q2 levels, closer to Q1",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "So we expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2, I think closer to Q1 in terms of percentage... I would assume that in Q4 EBIT percentage should be better than Q3.",
      "outcome": "Tracking. Q1 FY27 OPM was 21% and Q2 FY27 was 20%. Outcome for Q3 FY27 is not yet reported in the provided data.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Annualized improvement in Advanced Intermediates segment from next year onwards",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "And on an annualized basis from next year onwards, we should see further improvement.",
      "outcome": "Tracking. AI revenue already showed growth to INR 804 cr by Q1 FY27; full annual impact expected in FY28.",

    "delivered": 3,
